mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id FROM workspace_domains WHERE domain_key = #{domainKey} AND active = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (chat_room_id, workspace_member_id, chat, room_name, created) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{myWorkId}, 'GROUP', #{roomName}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select:
SELECT cr.chat_room_id chatRoomId, cr.room_name roomName, cr.workspace_member_id ownerWorkMemberId, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_members crm JOIN workspace_members wm ON crm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id WHERE crm.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id AND crm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 ) groupCount
FROM chat_rooms cr
JOIN workspace_members w_wm ON cr.workspace_member_id = w_wm.workspace_member_id
JOIN chat_room_members crm ON cr.chat_room_id = crm.chat_room_id AND crm.status = 0
JOIN workspace_members my_wm ON crm.workspace_member_id = my_wm.workspace_member_id AND my_wm.status = 0
JOIN workspace_domains wd ON my_wm.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id AND wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y'
WHERE cr.chat = 'GROUP' AND my_wm.member_id = #{loginMemberId} AND w_wm.workspace_id = my_wm.workspace_id ORDER BY cr.created DESC, cr.chat_room_id DESC

SELECT wm.workspace_member_id workMemberId, wm.member_id memberId, md.name name, wm.role role, md.profile profilePhoto FROM chat_room_members crm
JOIN workspace_members wm ON crm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id
JOIN members m ON wm.member_id = m.member_id
JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id
WHERE crm.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND crm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 AND m.status = 0 ORDER BY md.name ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_members WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND status = 0
